text:
Anya R: Hey — PR #4123 CI is red but only linux-shard-5. test_embedding_cache flakes. Can we nudge CI to rerun just that shard and avoid rebuilding images?
Sam K: Which CI run id? If it's GH Actions we can rerun a single job.
Anya R: run id 78901234. Failure snippet: ```
E AssertionError: cache miss
  tests/test_embedding_cache.py:42
```
BuildBot: [auto] Found run 78901234 (workflow: integration-matrix). Jobs: linux-shard-1..8. Failed: linux-shard-5 (container). Job id for shard-5 is 123456789.
Sam K: Quick options: `gh run rerun 78901234 --job \"linux-shard-5\"` — this reruns that job and usually reuses runner image layers so no full image rebuild.
Lina M: We also have an internal wrapper: `/ci retry --run 78901234 --job linux-shard-5 --no-image-rebuild` which sets preserve_cache on our runner API call. Use that if you want to be explicit.
Mike T: If you don't have gh set up: `curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN\" https://api.github.com/repos/<org>/<repo>/actions/jobs/123456789/rerun` (replace job id).
Anya R: will the rerun keep workspace files? I rely on a generated fixture in a previous step.
Lina M: Rerun starts from a fresh workspace. It preserves caching layers but not ephemeral workspace files. If you need a snapshot, upload it with `ci-snapshot` step and pass the S3 key into the rerun.
Sam K: For intermittent flakes we usually just rerun the failing job once, then mark the test flaky if it recurs.
Anya R: running `gh run rerun 78901234 --job \"linux-shard-5\"` now. Thanks! :thumbsup:
BuildBot: [auto] queued rerun for job linux-shard-5 (new job id 223344556). Estimated start ~30s.
Anya R: green ✅ — shard passed on rerun, merging. Filing small follow-up to add a retry decorator and better cache keys.
Mike T: Nice. If you want to avoid image changes on future runs, add `ci: no-image-change` label to the PR so targeted retries behave conservatively.
Lina M: noted on PR: \"flaky - targeted rerun used\".
Anya R: thanks everyone, closing the loop. @devops FYI.
